CHAPTER FOUR
Dear Prashant,

I know we haven't had hundreds of days together or a million memories in the same place. We've only met a few times, and most of our story has happened from a distance.

But somehow, even through a screen, you've become such an important part of my everyday life. ❤️

There are conversations I remember, random little moments that made me smile, and all those times when I wished you were just a little closer.

Maybe that's what makes our story different. We don't get to see each other whenever we want. We don't get those everyday little moments that other couples get. But every time we do meet, it feels extra special because we've waited for it.

I don't know what the future will look like, but I know I want to keep making memories with you — whether they're through a screen, on a call, in a random conversation at midnight, or finally together in the same place. 🥹❤️

Until then, I'll keep choosing you from wherever I am.

— Shruti ♡
